skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 5 combo strikes to a single target for 20% ATK DMG each.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 4 combo strikes to each enemy in the entire row for 35% ATK DMG each, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 50% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 4 combo strikes to each enemy in the entire row for 35% ATK DMG each, with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target and a 50% chance to inflict [Burn] on enemies in the main target's column, for 2 turns (DoT equal to 50% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. If there is a [Burning] enemy among the foes, you enter [Berserk] state (deals 30% more DMG when attacking).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. If there is a [Burning] enemy among the foes, you enter [Berserk] state (deals 40% more DMG when attacking).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. If there is a [Burning] enemy among the foes, you enter [Berserk] state (deals 45% more DMG when attacking).

effects.desc: Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
